findings.finding: Four cells show Mia front/back and one distinct generic caregiver front/back. Adult civilian presentation and non-hostile patient portrayal; no inferred authorization to represent other patients.

Three empty cots under two awnings, closed records cabinet, visibly distinct open circle-marked water bucket and covered stripe-marked waste bucket, outdoor bench and open gate. Bed count is proposal only; elevated walkway/ordinary care setting implies no completed quest or relocation.

Clean beige pipe feeds left basin; isolated copper segment has clear air gaps at both ends; separate dark drain enters covered right waste vat. Two cots, curtain, dry aisle and open right exit remain. Beige pipe retains a short capped rightward extension rather than the exact simplified elbow requested, but it does not contact copper or dark drain and does not undermine clean/dirty separation. Specific after-local-isolation state only, never default room, cure, NE certification or N8 completion. Hydraulics and collision unverified.

Two empty covered benches, open return doorway and broad dry ramp are visible above a separate lower drain. No queue, forced departure or destination assignment; blanket/jug are ordinary waiting props.

Four frames preserve one Mia, teal shawl, linen dress and blanket: outside doorway, turning, lowering to bench, resting seated. Doorway remains open; no helper, forced relocation, celebration or cure. Bench angles/position and figure anchors drift, so retain as gesture storyboard rather than final motion asset.

overall: No hard count or narrative-state contradiction found in selected review images. Preserve the explicit state/readiness caveats.
